name: Doujiang
description: Fresh-pressed hot soy milk served sweet or savory with vinegar and chili, paired with you tiao or shaobing.
ingredients: a handful of fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Gather and prep the glutinous rice and firm tofu, measuring everything out so it is ready to go.
Heat neutral vegetable oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat until warm but not smoking.
Add the grated fresh ginger and shiitake mushrooms, cooking gently until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the firm tofu, season with star anise, and cook until just done, about 10 mins.
Warm the glutinous rice alongside, turning once, until heated through and lightly toasted.
Plate the glutinous rice and spoon the cooked mixture over the top.
Drizzle with oyster sauce and finish with a sprinkle of chives.
Serve immediately while everything is warm.
tips: Prep the glutinous rice and firm tofu the night before to make busy mornings much easier.
Make a double batch — leftovers reheat beautifully for a quick weekday breakfast.
